steps.title: Initialize Project Structure
steps.description: Configure standard build directories and structure for NoiseRemover Pro app.

steps.title: Setup Manifest Configuration
steps.description: Define standard permissions including RECORD_AUDIO and storage access in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Create Core Color Resources
steps.description: Define a professional dark studio color palette in colors.xml.

steps.title: Define Vector Drawables
steps.description: Generate clean vectors for record, play, folder, and cleaning action icons.

steps.title: Implement Card Backgrounds
steps.description: Generate smooth rounded layout cards for noise control parameters and interactive visual panels.

steps.title: Design Studio Layout UI
steps.description: Create a sophisticated single-screen control room design with seekbars for Noise Gate, High-Pass hum filters, and file actions.

steps.title: Implement Digital Signal Processing (DSP) Engine
steps.description: Write mathematical 16-bit PCM algorithms in MainActivity for amplitude-gating (Noise Gate) and low/high cut filter computations.

steps.title: Configure Audio Recorder with Hardware Suppressor
steps.description: Integrate AudioRecord along with the native Android NoiseSuppressor API toggle.

steps.title: Develop File Import & Save Routines
steps.description: Implement file handlers to process WAV structures, parse headers, and output cleaned stereo/mono audio targets.

steps.title: Set Gradle Build Configurations
steps.description: Finalize app level and root gradle parameters strictly targeting SDK 34.

steps.title: Building NoiseRemover Pro
steps.description: Launch the compilation suite and finalize the artifact build.
